title: Paul de Kock’s
html_source:
Paul de = Poldy (Molly’s nickname for Bloom). So, Molly wants Poldy’s Cock?

PROPOSED SUGGESTION: No, she is asking for another novel by French novelist Charles Paul de Kock, whose novels were described as “as rather vulgar, but not immoral, demanding no literary training and gratifying no delicate taste.”
https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Charles_Paul_de_Kock
